wads.title: Hell Frontier
wads.author: ViolentBeetle
wads.notes:
Hell Frontier is a full megawad I set out to
gradually build when I started mapping. It's been
released in separate episodes over time, and now
finally it's complete.

The wad is made for compatibility level 2.
That is, limit-removing.
UMAPINFO support recommended.

After you have defeated Hell too many time, it went
dormant and UAC thought it would be safe to
colonize it and exploit for resources. Now it seems
the Hell has re-awakened, consuming the bases UAC
set up in Hell and threatening to spill over to
Earth once again.

wads.title: Dominus Diabolicus
wads.author: Bofu
wads.notes:
Dominus Diabolicus is a (mostly) solo project, and
an ambitious one at that. As my first real release,
I wanted to do something a bit more challenging
than just a single map, and instead, made a 33-map
megawad. The idea was to make something that feels
close to the spirit of the original Doom games
while also adding new enemies and more detailed
environments.

Difficulty starts off fairly standard. By the end
of Episode 1, things get a little spicy. By the
end, things are a considerable challenge but fair
for the average Doomer. Super secret levels,
however, are incredibly difficult and long.

Optional episodes have been implemented to start at
MAP01, MAP12, or MAP21, though continuous play is
supported. All maps were tested from a pistol start
on UV. Co-op and Deathmatch are all supported,
though some levels will not be as robustly
supported as others in that regard. Co-op enemies
are also present. Recommended difficulty is Ultra-
Violence for pistol starts, and Ultra-Violence with
co-op monsters or fast monsters enabled for
continuous play, for a challenging experience.

There are multiple new enemies in this megawad.
First is the Former Human Vanguard, who wields a
super shotgun and drops it upon death. Next is the
Summoner, an Arch-Vile variant that summons new
enemies instead of resurrecting existing ones and
functions as a miniboss. Third is the
Cybermancubus, whose fireballs deal lingering acid
damage based on where they land. Fourth is a custom
boss monster.

wads.title: Doom 2 In City Only
wads.author: myolden et al.
wads.notes:
Doom 2 In City Only is a 36 map megawad in MBF21
format featuring nothing but city maps. Some of
these maps are very large, so it is recommended you
play with OpenGL. The set was primarily tested in
dsda-doom. There are 6 secret maps (one per
episode) with the secret exit being in the middle
map of each episode. Jumping and freelook are not
intended for this set and will break some maps.

wads.title: Forsaken Compound
wads.author: Ivymagnapinna
wads.notes:
A 1-episode wad for Doom 1 set in a tech complex integrating itself into Hell.
There's blood in the pipes, flesh in the machinery, and the walls won't take their
eyes off you. Balanced with both continuous play and pistol starts in mind.
Gameplay is slaughtery in some parts, simple and atmosphere/puzzle-oriented in others,
I'd say it's definitely harder than your average Knee Deep in the Dead-style wad.
I aimed for a sense of difficulty progression and progression through locations/themes,
but I've got no story for any of these maps. Use your imagination.

wads.title: BITTER DREAM
wads.author: LVENdead
wads.notes:
A dark, cosmic adventure against an unyielding
force.

10 MBF21 maps comprised of 3 chapters with a loose
narrative thread and all original music composed by
me. Maps feature lots of exploration, incidental
combat, and larger setpieces. Maps start off easy
and escalate to manageable slaughter by the end.
Difficulty settings are fully implemented and
tailored to give you a decent challenge at your
desired skill level.

wads.title: Sleepwalking
wads.author: Ravendesk
wads.notes:
Sleepwalking is a snowy adventure across 3

and wanted to make maps to accompany them.

Wad was tested with dsda-doom 0.28.1 (-complevel
21) and GZDoom 4.8.2 (default compatibility).
However, wad uses a few tricks that don't work as
expected in gzdoom (secret transfers and some
visual tricks), so playing in dsda is preferable.

wads.title: Formless Mother
wads.author: Treehouseminis
wads.notes:
Formless Mother is a set of 5[MBF21] maps with a
dark, very red atmosphere.

I want the player to feel a sense of unease
in-between the set piece type combat.  Possibly
interesting enough to wander around with -nomo
even.

Heavily Inspired by the work of Suguru Tanaka,
liminal spaces, etc.

With an oppressive atmosphere, the combat can also
get oppressive at times on UV.  If you're used to
set piece combat/slaughter then its normal
difficulty but if you have a lot of trouble with
late sunlust on UV then I would start on HMP.

-1000 hp cybers
-arachnorbs

There is a path in MAP04 that leads to MAP31.
